lede: The biggest item this week lands at Ouray County's Planning Commission on August 19, where three public hearings include a proposed repeal of an entire section of county land use regulations — the kind of code change that reshapes what's possible on the ground for years to come. Also on the 19th, the BOCC sits as the Housing Authority to dig into regional affordable housing compliance, and Telluride's P&Z takes its first formal look at a school district employee housing proposal. HARC has a full slate too, with the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road coming in for preliminary large-scale review.
